decisionReason: WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy currently prohibits use of WhatsApp Business Services to buy, sell, promote or otherwise facilitate gambling; direct group automation capability for the intended production path is not independently verified as authorized.

officialSources.title: WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy
officialSources.finding: Business Services prohibit buying, selling, promoting or facilitating certain regulated/restricted goods and services including gambling; the policy states the prohibitions apply even if the business has local/global licenses or approvals.

officialSources.title: WhatsApp Business Solution Terms
officialSources.finding: Use of the Business Solution must comply with technical/product documentation and the WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy.

officialSources.title: WhatsApp Terms of Service
officialSources.finding: Terms restrict illegal/impermissible bulk or auto-messaging and non-personal use unless otherwise authorized.

officialSources.title: Unauthorized use of automated or bulk messaging on WhatsApp
officialSources.finding: WhatsApp warns against unauthorized automated/bulk messaging and describes enforcement risk.

officialSources.title: WhatsApp Legal Resources
officialSources.finding: Legal hub reviewed; WhatsApp indicates Business terms updates scheduled to take effect September 23, 2026, so evidence must be re-reviewed before any future promotion decision.

reconsiderationRequirements: confirm actual operating jurisdiction and legal status of the betting activity
obtain current official platform evidence for the exact connector/capability
prove the intended betting-related use is permitted under the then-current WhatsApp policies
obtain any platform approvals and local licenses/permissions required
complete physical QA, security, soak and promotion evidence for the candidate SHA
safeAlternative: Keep SOURCE read-only and use local/LAB tools for analysis and operator assistance. Human operators may act through an independently lawful and platform-permitted workflow; the software must not enable direct automated production group writing while the gate is NO_GO.
